notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
